card.name: Numbers inside dates and references
card.fires_on: Digits or number words in the middle of a date, clock time, name or citation, such as the 6 in 6:00 or the 9 in a Bull date. Seen mostly in older historical or literary web text.

modes.label: Dates and times
modes.description: A digit in a day of the month or clock time, often followed by a colon, ordinal ending or month.

modes.label: Numbers in names and citations
modes.description: A digit inside a numbered title, unit name or reference number.

modes.label: Spelled-out numbers
modes.description: Part of a number word or hyphenated number in an old-style text.

card.writes: It seems to push toward number-related continuations such as measures and numbered items.
card.plain: It fires on a number partway through a date, time or reference, mainly in old historical prose.
